subject.title: fix(security): exclude test files from plugin code-safety scans (#82469)

question: Should test-file exclusion also apply to installed-skill `skills.code_safety` scans, or should this fix be limited to plugin `plugins.code_safety` scans only?
rationale: The diff changes a shared security-audit helper, so accepting it decides a broader audit coverage boundary than the plugin-focused issue requires.

options.title: Limit to plugin scans
options.body: Thread an explicit option through the helper and pass `excludeTestFiles: true` only from the plugin collector, preserving current installed-skill coverage.

options.title: Accept broader skill exclusion
options.body: Keep the shared-helper change only if maintainers intentionally accept installed-skill test-path exclusion and require proof for that broader scan boundary.

options.title: Pause for audit-scope policy
options.body: Hold the PR until the canonical issue settles whether test-file exclusion, string masking, or another audit strategy should be the permanent fix.

recommendation.title: Limit to plugin scans
recommendation.body: Thread an explicit option through the helper and pass `excludeTestFiles: true` only from the plugin collector, preserving current installed-skill coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent security-audit hardening work in `audit-extra.async.ts` makes this the best available history signal for a scan-boundary decision.
